findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Order/Filter/Tendsto.lean:104 `theorem Tendsto.congr' … (hl : f₁ =ᶠ[l₁] f₂)` vs :112 `theorem Tendsto.congr … (h : ∀ x, f₁ x = f₂ x)`; same split at Mathlib/Analysis/Asymptotics/Basic.lean:182 `IsBigO.congr'`. Call sites EpsilonEridani/Particles/Meson/Pdf/LargeX.lean:107,185 use `h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => …)`. No local precedent: this is the repo's only `congr` lemma taking `=ᶠ`.
findings.fix: Rename to `HasLargeXExponent.congr'`, and (optionally) add `HasLargeXExponent.congr (hg : ∀ x, g x = g' x)`, which the two call sites in Meson/Pdf/LargeX.lean want.
findings.issue: `HasLargeXExponent.congr` takes `hg : g =ᶠ[𝓝[<] 1] g'`. Mathlib systematically names the eventual-equality variant `congr'` and reserves `congr` for the pointwise `∀ x, f₁ x = f₂ x` form, so consumers reaching for `.congr` with a pointwise equality will fail.

findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/Particles/Meson/Pdf/LargeX.lean:148-150 statement; contrast EpsilonEridani/Particles/Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:355-357 `mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf … = M.valenceModelWeight s * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2))⁻¹`.
findings.fix: Rename to `mellinMoment_countingRuleModelPdf_eq_valenceModelPdf_of_le_one` (or `…_eq_mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf_of_le_one`), so the equated right-hand side appears in the name.
findings.issue: `mellinMoment_countingRuleModelPdf_of_le_one` names only the LHS; its conclusion is `mellinMoment countingRuleModelPdf n s Q2 = mellinMoment valenceModelPdf n s Q2`. By the local precedent `mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf` (Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:355) and `mellinMoment_modelPdf_zero_one` (Parton/PDF/Model.lean:209), that name reads as a closed-form value of the counting-rule model's moment, which it is not.

summary: Names are mostly consistent with the existing `valenceModelPdf`/`modelPdf` families, but two break convention: a `congr` lemma whose hypothesis is an eventual equality (Mathlib reserves that name for the pointwise version), and a moment lemma whose name omits the equality it actually proves.
